newsitem.title: USA: Kitty Hawk four-month Dec 31 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Kitty Hawk four-month Dec 31 net rises.

text.p: Kitty Hawk Inc said Wednesday its net income for the four-month transition period ended December 31 totalled $5.3 million, up 11 percent from the unaudited $4.8 million for the same period a year ago.
The company, which provides charter air freight and logistics services, said net income in December increased 31 percent from a year earlier, to an unaudited $3.7 million from $2.8 million.
Kitty Hawk is making the transition from a fiscal year-end of August 31 to December 31.

"After recasting its reported results to a calendar quarter basis, the company said that net income for both the third and fourth calendar quarters, as well as the year ending December 31, 1996, exceeded published earnings estimates," Kitty Hawk said.
It also said it had completed the purchase of two more Boeing 727-200 aircraft, bringing the number of fleet additions since its October 1996 initial public offering to five.
